       COUNT(*) AS matching_owned_items

       COUNT(*) AS matching_quoted_requests

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ServiceJob j WHERE j.job_id=%(job_id)s AND j.job_status='READY_FOR_RETURN' AND j.returned_date IS NULL AND j.returned_by_staff_id IS NULL AND %(returned_date)s>=j.received_date AND %(returned_date)s>=j.repair_completed_date AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection i WHERE i.job_id=j.job_id AND i.inspection_status='COMPLETED' AND i.overall_result='PASS' AND i.inspection_date<=%(returned_date)s AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection newer WHERE newer.job_id=i.job_id AND newer.inspection_round>i.inspection_round))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Staff WHERE staff_id=%(returned_by_staff_id)s AND active_status=1) AS ok;
SELECT ri.request_id INTO @op_request_id FROM RequestItem ri JOIN ServiceJob j ON j.request_item_id=ri.request_item_id WHERE j.job_id=%(job_id)s;
UPDATE ServiceJob SET job_status='CLOSED',returned_date=%(returned_date)s,returned_by_staff_id=%(returned_by_staff_id)s WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s;

UPDATE ServiceRequest r SET r.request_status='CLOSED' WHERE r.request_id=@op_request_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RequestItem ri WHERE ri.request_id=r.request_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RequestItem ri LEFT JOIN ServiceJob j ON j.request_item_id=ri.request_item_id WHERE ri.request_id=r.request_id AND (ri.item_status<>'RECEIVED' OR j.job_id IS NULL OR j.job_status<>'CLOSED'));

SELECT j.job_id,j.job_status,j.returned_date,r.request_id,r.request_status FROM ServiceJob j JOIN RequestItem ri ON ri.request_item_id=j.request_item_id JOIN ServiceRequest r ON r.request_id=ri.request_id WHERE j.job_id=%(job_id)s;

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ServiceJob WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND job_status IN ('RECEIVED','IN_REPAIR','REWORK_REQUIRED') AND %(repair_completed_date)s>=received_date) AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(%(repair_description)s))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND (inspection_status='IN_PROGRESS' OR inspection_date>%(repair_completed_date)s)) AS ok;

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ServiceJob WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND job_status='SUBMITTED_FOR_INSPECTION' AND repair_completed_date IS NOT NULL AND repair_description IS NOT NULL AND %(inspection_date)s>=repair_completed_date AND technician_id<>%(inspector_id)s) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Staff WHERE staff_id=%(inspector_id)s AND role='INSPECTOR' AND active_status=1) AND %(result)s IN ('PASS','FAIL') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND inspection_status='IN_PROGRESS') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND inspection_date>%(inspection_date)s) AS ok;

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ServiceJob WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND job_status='SUBMITTED_FOR_INSPECTION' AND repair_completed_date IS NOT NULL AND repair_description IS NOT NULL AND %(inspection_date)s>=repair_completed_date AND technician_id<>%(inspector_id)s) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Staff WHERE staff_id=%(inspector_id)s AND role='INSPECTOR' AND active_status=1) AND %(result)s IN ('PASS','FAIL') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND inspection_status='IN_PROGRESS') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s AND inspection_date>%(inspection_date)s) AS ok;
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(inspection_round),0)+1 INTO @op_round FROM Inspection WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s;
INSERT INTO Inspection(job_id,inspector_id,inspection_round,inspection_status) VALUES (%(job_id)s,%(inspector_id)s,@op_round,'IN_PROGRESS');
SET @op_inspection_id=LAST_INSERT_ID();
INSERT INTO InspectionResult(inspection_id,criterion_name,result,remarks) VALUES (@op_inspection_id,%(criterion_name)s,%(result)s,%(remarks)s);
UPDATE Inspection SET inspection_status='COMPLETED',inspection_date=%(inspection_date)s,overall_result=%(result)s WHERE inspection_id=@op_inspection_id;
UPDATE ServiceJob SET job_status=CASE WHEN %(result)s='FAIL' THEN 'REWORK_REQUIRED' ELSE 'READY_FOR_RETURN' END WHERE job_id=%(job_id)s;
SELECT @op_inspection_id AS inspection_id,@op_round AS inspection_round;

UPDATE ServiceRequest SET request_status='IN_PROGRESS' WHERE request_id=@btr;
SET @btold=(SELECT customer_name FROM Customer WHERE customer_id=@btc);
UPDATE Customer SET customer_name='' WHERE customer_id=@btc;
